prompt: For the queue with the most SLA risk, break the at-risk disputes down by reason code.

results.text: queue_disputes_escalated has the most SLA risk. Its at-risk disputes break down as PAID_BY_OTHER_MEANS (**12**, $7,022.94) and DUPLICATE_CHARGE (**1**, $174.81).

sql.command: SELECT reason_code, SUM(sla_risk_count) AS sla_risk_count, SUM(sla_risk_amount_total) AS sla_risk_amount_total FROM aa_dispute_sla_risk WHERE queue_id = 'queue_disputes_escalated' GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY sla_risk_count DESC
